notes: All three tools ran clean on the new files. Semgrep emitted only INFO gas/style rules (0 security). Slither's deep reentrancy detector did NOT flag NudgeRatchet._dispatch or the hook's pull() because both are nonReentrant-guarded and use SafeERC20. The only flag on a new file with non-trivial impact is Aderyn's constructor reentrancy on NudgeRatchet, which is a false positive (view decimals() call before state writes). Test-dir compile error (test/poc-ECON-RAW-001.t.sol) is out of scope and did not affect src analysis.

findings.description: Reentrancy: state (_token, batchMinter) written after external IERC20Metadata.decimals() call in constructor. LIKELY FALSE POSITIVE: decimals() is a view call on a deploy-time-trusted token, no value/control transfer; benign.

setRecipient lacks a zero-check on newRecipient. Intentional per NatSpec (zero re-arms the hook; pull() reverts via RecipientUnset while zero). Corroborated by Aderyn 'Address State Variable Set Without Checks' at line 92.
nonReentrant is not the first modifier on pull() (onlyOwnerOrRecipient runs first). QA/ordering nit; access check before reentrancy guard is the conventional and safe ordering here.

appendixWholeProject.description: Multiplication on the result of a prior division in _psmDonate (precision loss).
Multiple ignored return values: IERC4626 deposit/withdraw, ISkyPSM.buyGem, IBalancerVault.unlock/addLiquidity.
External calls inside a loop (balanceOf, v1.burn, v2.mintFor) in migrate(); also Aderyn 'Costly operations inside loop' and 'Loop contains require/revert'.
Events emitted after external calls (reentrancy-events, low impact) in _executeMint/mintFor/burn/setDispatcherActive, migrate, _psmDonate, unlockCallback.
abi.encodePacked() hash collision risk flagged in V1 and V2 NFTMinter. Pre-existing (not in story-035 scope); evaluate against prior-run dedup/ledger.
